title: Tangy TD
release_date: 2026-03-09 (Steam, PC) [CONFIRMED – Steam store; Inven Global; Mein-MMO]
early_access_date: n/a (released directly as 1.0; free Steam demo app 2248860 beforehand)
team_size: 1 (solo dev) [CONFIRMED – GamesRadar, PC Gamer, Inven Global and GameStar all describe a solo developer]
country: Germany [CONFIRMED – Mein-MMO ('Dev from Germany…'); GameStar ('ein deutscher Solo-Entwickler')]
developer_background: Tangy TD is his first Steam release; he previously published several small games on itch.io as cakez77 (e.g. 'Tangy Survivors', a Vampire Survivors-style game in C++). Worked ~4 years (1,400+ days) on Tangy TD while livestreaming development daily on Twitch ('morning streams'). GameStar reports he had feared for his livelihood before the launch.
platforms_and_store_links: Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245620/Tangy_TD/ (appid originally titled 'Cakez TD') ; Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248860/Tangy_TD_Demo/ ; itch.io (older games): https://cakez77.itch.io
business_model: Premium, $9.99 [CONFIRMED – Steam store / games-stats.com]; seen at 12% and 20% off ($7.99). No DLC found.
units_or_downloads: 3,676 copies by the evening of 2026-03-10 and 28,078 copies after 1 week (~2026-03-16) [CONFIRMED – dev's Steam dashboard shown on stream, via Mein-MMO / GamesRadar / PC Gamer]. ~90,000 copies after 1 month (~2026-04-09) [ESTIMATE – confirmed $788,449 month-1 gross ÷ $8.73 week-1 average gross per unit]. ~95,000–110,000 by 2026-10-08 [ESTIMATE – month-1 figure plus long tail implied by +~200 reviews since July]. Raijin's ~38,800 units (2026-07-13, medium confidence) conflicts with the dev's dashboard and is disregarded.
peak_concurrent_players: 1,202 all-time peak on 2026-03-21 [ESTIMATE – SteamBase; Tracker.gg ~1,200]. Monthly peaks: Apr 254, May 50, Jun 104; about 12–21 CCU in mid-2026 snapshots [SteamBase / Tracker.gg / Raijin].
steam_reviews: 92% positive, 'Very Positive', ~2026-04 [Inven Global]; 1,446 reviews at 91% on 2026-07-13 [Raijin]; 1,531 reviews at 89% 'Very Positive' on ~2026-10-08 [Steam store snapshot]; recent 30-day 66% of 33.
implied_review_multiplier: ~60–70 [ESTIMATE – ~90k revenue-derived units at 1 month ÷ an estimated ~1,300–1,400 reviews at that time; not a clean same-date calibration]. High for a single-player TD; likely because a large share of buyers came from his streaming community and viral clip audience rather than heavy-reviewing genre fans. Note: plain Boxleiter (1,531 × 40 ≈ 61k) would underestimate sales by about 40%.
gross_revenue: $245,123 Steam gross after week 1 [CONFIRMED – dev dashboard on stream, via GamesRadar/PC Gamer/Mein-MMO]; $788,449 Steam gross after ~1 month (~2026-04-09) [CONFIRMED – dev dashboard on stream, via GamesRadar]. ~$0.85M–$0.95M by 2026-10-08 [ESTIMATE – month-1 plus long tail at ~$7–8.7 per unit]. Raijin's $329k estimate (July 2026) conflicts and is disregarded.
net_revenue: Steam dashboard 'net' (after refunds, chargebacks and VAT, before Valve's cut): $197,847 after week 1 and $635,611 after ~1 month [CONFIRMED – dev dashboard via GamesRadar]. Developer take after Valve's 30% cut: ~$445k for month 1 and ~$0.48M–$0.53M to date [ESTIMATE – Steam net × 0.70; the spec formula (gross × 0.70 × 0.93) would give ~$513k for month 1; the dashboard shows VAT/refund leakage of ~19%, not 7%]. Self-published, no publisher split.
production_cost: ~$288k opportunity cost [ESTIMATE – 1 person × ~48 months × $6k/month (Germany lean-indie rate)]; partly offset by Twitch income during development (no data). No disclosed cash budget; custom engine means no engine fees.
development_time: ~4 years (1,400+ days, ~2022 → March 2026) [CONFIRMED – dev via GamesRadar / 3DJuegos ('1,460 days') / Mein-MMO]
why_popular: A solid, polished tower defense (89–92% positive) amplified by a human story: a solo dev who livestreamed 4 years of C++ development daily, then broke down in tears live on Twitch when he saw $245k in week 1. The clip went viral (r/LivestreamFails), creating a second wave of press worldwide (GamesRadar, PC Gamer, GameStar, 3DJuegos, LevelUp, Canaltech, Chinese and Russian sites) and support purchases. The month-1 'wife guesses the revenue' stream generated another GamesRadar story.
marketing_channels: Daily Twitch dev streams (~17.1k followers, ~211 average viewers; #4 Software & Game Dev channel per TwitchMetrics); launch stream celebrated by 30,000+ people (Mein-MMO, likely raid-boosted); YouTube devlogs about building a game in C++ (subscriber count not found); free Steam demo; viral emotional clip → Reddit (r/LivestreamFails) → international press. No publisher or paid ads reported.
engine: Custom C++ engine, no third-party engine [CONFIRMED – Inven Global ('built from scratch without using a third-party game engine'); Mein-MMO/GameStar ('C++ rather than Unity')]
ai_feasibility_justification: AI can: write TD systems quickly (pathing, targeting, wave spawner, upgrades, economy, save/UI) in an off-the-shelf engine (no need for a custom C++ engine), generate pixel-art sprites/tiles/icons/VFX, SFX and music, and draft store text. | AI cannot: balance many towers/enemies/maps so the strategy stays interesting, create enough content depth for a paid TD, playtest, or replace a multi-year live-streaming community and an authentic viral moment, which drove most of the sales. | Toolset: Claude Code + Godot 4 (or Unity 2D / raylib-C++ for engine-from-scratch content), Retro Diffusion/PixelLab/Scenario for pixel art, ElevenLabs SFX, Suno/Udio music, GodotSteam.
solo_ai_mvp_cost_time: 3–5 weeks, ~$150–$400 (Claude Pro/Max, pixel-art generator, audio subs, $100 Steam Direct). Excludes developer living costs.
solo_ai_polished_cost_time: 4–8 months, ~$2,000–$6,000 (subs, pixel-art polish freelancer, capsule art, playtests, small marketing). Excludes developer living costs; building a streaming/devlog audience takes longer than the game itself.

data_conflicts: '$600k in a month' is the Steam dashboard *net* ($635,611; gross $788,449), not gross. The brief's '$600k+ gross' was relabelled. Week 1 is reported as '$250k' (rounded gross $245,123); Spanish/Portuguese outlets say '$245k'. Raijin (38.8k units / $329k by July) and games-stats.com (~$280k) massively undercount vs the dev's dashboard, so the dev data is used. Review %: 92% (Apr) → 91% (Jul) → 89% (Oct). Twitch activity: TwitchMetrics active vs Streams Charts 'inactive last 30 days'. YouTube subscriber count: not found.
notes: Strong evidence that 'building in public' via daily livestreams plus an authentic emotional launch moment can carry a plain-genre game to ~$0.8M gross. CCU (1.2k peak) badly understates commercial success here; revenue/CCU ratio is very high because TD sessions are short and buyers were often supporters. Typical Steam leakage: the dashboard showed ~19% lost to VAT/refunds before Valve's 30%.
